verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both enlarge the top-left decorative circle so it reaches into the middle of the canvas. Both keep the original's problems: the subtitle sits right on top of the CTA pill, the CTA is nearly touching the bottom edge, and the bottom-right circle runs behind the headline and subtitle. In A, the text in the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge and in the CTA has slipped a few pixels down from centre. B keeps that text centred in its pills, as in the original, so B is slightly better.
